floorPlans.introduction: Browse the complete Neem sheets published by Deyaar, including the original unit-position keys.
floorPlans.note: Published totals include exterior areas. Studio 01, 1 BR 02, 2 BR 01 and 3 BR 03 totals differ from the displayed components by 1 sq ft. Confirm the specific home’s contractual area.

review.gallery: 10 native-resolution renders from the dedicated Neem brochure. Shared community amenities are identified in the captions. Two actual photographs come from Deyaar’s shared Elm, Ember and Neem update and retain that group scope. The source gives no visible inspection date.
review.location: Physical page 11 marks the shared ParkFive community. It publishes 15 minutes to Dubai Exhibition Centre/Expo City and 25 minutes to Dubai airport. The map and text were visually checked. The page uses named directions because a verified building entrance point was unavailable.
review.floorPlans: 17 complete original plan sheets. Each type and printed total was visually checked. Studio 01, 1 BR 02, 2 BR 01 and 3 BR 03 totals differ from the displayed components by 1 sq ft.
